deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 for autumn 2027 to be considered for funding; applications by July 1 are considered without funding.
deadline.quote: U.S. & International Applicants Will be considered for funding Dec 15

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required; you can leave that part of the application blank.
gre_general.quote: Our department does not require the GRE for admission to our graduate programs. Applicants can leave this portion of the application blank.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You may mention faculty whose research fits you in your statement; no rule on prior faculty agreement is stated.
supervisor.quote: You may also mention faculty members whose research aligns with your interests, along with a brief explanation of your choices.

funding.value: Funding comes through fellowships, TAs and RAs; the pages do not say how many PhD students are funded.
funding.quote: The department most commonly employs three types of financial assistance for graduate students: fellowships, teaching assistantships and research assistantships.

entry_route.value: You can enter the PhD directly without an MS or after an MS; PhD applicants with an MS need an MS GPA of 3.5+.
entry_route.quote: Pre-M.S. Direct entry into the Ph.D. program without an MS degree | Post-M.S. Entry with an M.S. degree from another University

also.quote: Ph.D. applicants are required to have an M.S. cumulative GPA of 3.5 or better.

notes: Aeronautics & Astronautics runs a separate PhD, not covered here.
